steps.title: Pairs on the intercardinals
steps.rule: Pair up on your intercardinal, about 11m out, with the healer or melee DPS of the pair a little nearer the north-south line. Whichever pairs end up beside the dark clone take Mighty Magic, the pair nearest the fire clone shares Top-tier Slam.

MainTank.rule: North-east with melee DPS A, on the east side of the pair.

MeleeDpsA.rule: North-east with the main tank, on the north side of the pair.

ShieldHealer.rule: South-east with the caster, on the south side of the pair.

CasterDps.rule: South-east with the shield healer, on the east side of the pair.

OffTank.rule: South-west with melee DPS B, on the west side of the pair.

MeleeDpsB.rule: South-west with the off tank, on the south side of the pair.

RegenHealer.rule: North-west with the physical ranged, on the north side of the pair.

PhysRangedDps.rule: North-west with the regen healer, on the west side of the pair.

steps.title: Stack behind the boss
steps.rule: Sprint south and stack just behind the boss, out of the half Snaking Kick hits.

steps.title: Second clones: fire or dark
steps.rule: Players with Dark Resistance Down take fire, the rest take dark. Find the outer fire clone's intercardinal: the inner dark clone stands on the same diagonal, halfway in.

MainTank.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack in the middle with the other melee to share the inner fire. Without it: bait the inner dark from the earlier of the two numbers beside it (1-2-3-4 order), a step in toward the centre so you stay farther from the outer fire than the fire stack.

OffTank.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack in the middle with the other melee to share the inner fire. Without it: bait the inner dark from the earlier of the two numbers beside it (1-2-3-4 order), a step in toward the centre so you stay farther from the outer fire than the fire stack.

MeleeDpsA.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack in the middle with the other melee to share the inner fire. Without it: bait the inner dark from the later of the two numbers beside it (1-2-3-4 order), a step in toward the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack in the middle with the other melee to share the inner fire. Without it: bait the inner dark from the later of the two numbers beside it (1-2-3-4 order), a step in toward the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack with the other ranged on the earlier letter beside the outer fire (A-B-C-D order) to share it. Without it: bait the outer dark from the earlier of its two letters.

ShieldHealer.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack with the other ranged on the earlier letter beside the outer fire (A-B-C-D order) to share it. Without it: bait the outer dark from the earlier of its two letters.

PhysRangedDps.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack with the other ranged on the earlier letter beside the outer fire (A-B-C-D order) to share it. Without it: bait the outer dark from the later of its two letters.

CasterDps.rule: With Dark Resistance Down: stack with the other ranged on the earlier letter beside the outer fire (A-B-C-D order) to share it. Without it: bait the outer dark from the later of its two letters.

steps.cue: The split clones dash into a fire-dark-fire-dark line

steps.title: Tank north, party south for Double Sobat
steps.rule: Sprint back behind the boss and stack south of it.

MainTank.rule: Stand just north of the boss and take the marked Double Sobat on an invulnerability, facing the boss away from the party.

steps.title: Dodge the follow-up kick
steps.rule: Watch which way the boss turns after the first kick: the follow-up hits that half. Sprint to the opposite side, about 10m out from the boss, and stack there.

MainTank.rule: Go about 9m out to the right of the follow-up kick (looking the way it kicks), just behind the boss's line, to take your Esoteric Finisher circle away from everyone.

OffTank.rule: Go about 9m out to the left of the follow-up kick (looking the way it kicks), just behind the boss's line, to take your Esoteric Finisher circle away from everyone.
